hotspots.title: Manuel Adorni’s corruption scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Argentina's Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni faces intensifying scrutiny over his and his wife's adherence to the 'Fiscal Innocence' tax regime amid an ongoing investigation into their wealth. Multiple articles detail the couple's application to the simplified tax system, raising questions about undeclared assets and potential illicit enrichment.
hotspots.affect: The scandal commands disproportionate attention due to its high-profile nature, moral outrage over perceived hypocrisy, and the potential for systemic corruption within the Milei administration.

hotspots.title: PP-Vox coalition deals reshape Spanish regional governments
hotspots.blurb: Spain's conservative PP and far-right Vox parties have formalized coalition agreements in multiple regions, including Castilla y León and Andalusia. These deals prioritize 'national preference' policies, restrict immigration, and reshape local governance, sparking polarized reactions from opposition parties and civil society.
hotspots.affect: The coalitions dominate coverage due to their ideological significance, potential to normalize far-right policies, and the high-stakes political maneuvering involved in securing regional power.

hotspots.title: Trump’s explosive NBC interview meltdown
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's abrupt exit from an NBC interview with Kristen Welker has reignited debates over his temperament and media relations. The incident, framed as a 'meltdown,' has drawn comparisons to past confrontations and raised questions about his handling of critical questioning on foreign policy and domestic issues.
hotspots.affect: The interview commands attention due to its dramatic framing, the high-profile nature of the participants, and the broader implications for Trump's public image and political strategy.

hotspots.title: AfD’s surge in German regional elections
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) continues to gain traction in regional polls, with recent surveys showing the party leading in multiple states. The surge has sparked debates over democratic resilience, the effectiveness of cordon sanitaires, and the AfD's influence on national politics.
hotspots.affect: The AfD's rise commands attention due to its implications for German democracy, the potential for far-right governance, and the polarized reactions it elicits from mainstream parties and civil society.

hotspots.title: Far-right riots erupt in Belfast after knife attack
hotspots.blurb: Violent protests orchestrated by far-right and loyalist groups have erupted in Belfast following a knife attack by a Sudanese refugee. The unrest, which includes arson and clashes with police, has been amplified by far-right figures like Tommy Robinson and Nigel Farage, sparking fears of escalating racial tensions.
hotspots.affect: The riots dominate coverage due to their violent nature, the racialized framing of the incident, and the broader implications for community cohesion and immigration policy in the UK.
